description: Japanese depreciation for sole proprietors: under 100,000 JPY expensed, under 200,000 lump-sum 3 years, SME blue filers under 400,000 (acquired from 2026-04-01; 300,000 before) expensed up to 3M a year until 2029-03-31 (措法 第28条の2, NTA No.2100), else straight-line with the 別表第八 rate (ceil(1/life, 3 decimals)), first year by months used, down to 1 JPY. Japan, as of 2026-11-21 (e-Gov current law and NTA Tax Answer). General information and estimates only; individual tax advice and return preparation are reserved to 税理士 (税理士法 第52条).

acquired.description: Date first used in the business

life.description: Statutory useful life in years (PC 4, car 6, kei car 4, wooden building 22)

sme.description: Small business (blue filer with up to 500 employees)
